minutes.headline: Finance Committee put off investing town funds until the treasurer attends; primary school mini-splits will miss this summer.
minutes.summary: A short meeting without the finance director. Members discussed investing idle town funds and consolidating accounts, and will invite the treasurer next time. They also covered tax abatements, the primary school air conditioning project (summer window closed), the town manager's report, minutes, a master plan committee report, and a departing member.

budget_items.topic: Money market yields for town funds
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said federal money market funds yield well above four percent with minimal risk and the town should look at them.
Guardrail repair awarded to Premier Fence, paid from state winter recovery assistance funds, which were extended past June.
Bid received from Powell Construction, paid from the fiscal 23 capital plan appropriation.
The only proposal came in well above estimate; the select board voted to appropriate additional ARPA funds to cover the difference.
The consultant's contract was fulfilled and paid from ARPA.
Assessors finalized abatement applications; interest owed will add to the total.
The fund is expected to cover abatements plus interest; interest to date was small.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee took no vote on investing idle town funds; the chair will invite the treasurer to the next meeting to discuss options and consolidating accounts.
Members discussed that money market funds could yield more than the town now earns, and the chair will ask the treasurer and the financial planning company about investment rules.
The primary school air conditioning project missed this summer's window; funds could be re-appropriated at a special town meeting, and the item is to be revisited in the fall.
The town manager reported that the revaluation proposal came in well above estimate and the select board voted to appropriate additional ARPA funds to cover the difference.
The August 10th meeting was dropped from the schedule.

why_it_matters: Where the town parks idle cash decides how much interest it earns, and the committee has not yet heard from the treasurer who would carry out any change.
Primary school cooling will not be installed this summer, and money for it may need a vote at a special town meeting, which residents would be asked to take.
watch_next: The treasurer's appearance at the next Finance Committee meeting on investment options and consolidating town funds.
Whether a special town meeting is called to re-appropriate the primary school air conditioning funds, with the item revisited in the fall.
